answer: Follow the money's shadow, not the voice. The ledger keeps a funding-and-interaction graph and cuts it at random epochs: any sparrow of accounts sharing a deposit route, a coordinator, or a burst of signup timing loses weight as a flock. Seen through the prism of graph connectivity, even a tide of fresh aliases collapses into one suspiciously tight cluster. Breaking that costs a farmer months of unrelated, individually funded lives per clone - attention no farm can borrow.
